fields.name: compressive_strength_class
fields.rationale: The compressive strength class (e.g., C32/40) is a key property of concrete that indicates its load-bearing capacity and is crucial for structural applications.

fields.name: exposure_class
fields.rationale: Exposure class (e.g., CIIIA) indicates the environmental conditions the concrete is designed to withstand, such as freeze-thaw cycles or chemical exposure.

fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a fundamental property of concrete that affects its weight and structural performance.
